guide.text: The Joker's signature gear. Increases damage over time and gradually boosts Spiritual Amplification. Each successful attack increases the damage the target takes (stackable). Combined with both damage over time and his self-scaling damage, The Joker becomes an unstoppable menace as the fight drags on.
